## Page pg1

Why did you become a coach?

I became a coach because I wanted to be a mentor for, for young athletes like I had whenever I was growing up. They all made a lasting impact on my life. It sounds cheesy, but it's very, very true. And I still talk to all of my, like the 2 biggest coaches in my life to this day.

Why softball?

Because softball is the love of my life growing up. That's all I did, and I had a lot of success in it, and I wanted to share everything I learned with everybody else.

What's your favorite thing about new home?

I love the small community. I've been to bigger schools, and at LCU, and I loved them both, but this is just such a tight-knit family, and it's just, it's special. You don't really get this type of atmosphere anywhere else.

What's your favorite season?

summer. Yeah. Okay, yeah. I love the summer, I like summer because I like wakeboarding. It's to go to the lake, get to do, like, all those kinds of things.

What's one thing that you do with your family around Christmas time?

We like to watch the National Lampoon Christmas vacation together, and try to go at least on, like, one small trip.

What's one place you would visit if you could?

Australia. Why? Because I've just always been fascinated with it. I follow this girl on YouTube and, um, I've been following her for years, and she's a really cool girl .I think it's awesome.
